title: Family Care Shift Receipt
oneLiner: Adult siblings turn elder-care tasks, missed work, and Medicaid paperwork into a fair weekly responsibility receipt.
theme: 건강 / 외로움 / 자산 방어 - family duty, caregiver burnout, unpaid labor, and resentment prevention.
targetUser: Adult children coordinating care for aging parents, siblings negotiating responsibility, and family caregivers applying for support programs.
keyUx: Care lead logs appointment rides, medication refills, phone calls, forms, missed work, and out-of-pocket spend; the app turns invisible labor into a shareable weekly receipt and next-shift handoff.
requiredUiSections: This-week care load header with hours, money, missed work, and emotional-risk notes
Task timeline for appointments, meds, errands, calls, meals, and paperwork
Sibling contribution matrix with promised vs completed work
Benefits paperwork tracker for caregiver program, Medicaid, respite, and doctor forms
Care fairness receipt with hours, cost, urgency, and next owner
Family message composer that is direct without sounding accusatory
Emergency handoff card with medications, contacts, and next appointment
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Family Care Shift Receipt" for adult siblings coordinating care for an aging parent. The first screen must be a working family-care workspace with a weekly care-load header, task timeline, sibling contribution matrix, benefits paperwork tracker, care fairness receipt, family message composer, and emergency handoff card. Use realistic sample data: one daughter handling most rides, one sibling sending money, medication refills, doctor appointment, Medicaid caregiver paperwork, missed work hours, and a Sunday family check-in. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with soft reassuring surfaces, warm neutrals, gentle accountability cues, and obvious next-step buttons that reduce family defensiveness. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
